entities.name: Adonis García
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adonis García Arrieta is a Cuban former professional baseball third baseman. He played in the Cuban National Series from 2004 through 2011, and then defected from Cuba. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves from 2015 to 2017 and also played in the KBO League for the LG Twins in 2018.
